tools.name: about_slsbmb_ai
tools.description: What SLSBMB AI is and how it works, step by step: the free AI interview, the AI Outreach Playbook and how deep its research goes, AI Contacts, the managed Sending Engine and the workspace, with results so far, who it serves and the headline prices. Use it when someone asks what SLSBMB AI is, how an AI outbound service works, or whether it fits their outbound sales, fundraising, partnership, hiring, job-search or press outreach. For each price with what it includes, use get_pricing; for what one budget buys, estimate_sending_engine; to weigh SLSBMB AI against another option, compare_options.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Every SLSBMB AI price with what each one includes — the free AI interview, the AI Outreach Playbook, AI Contacts and the all-inclusive Sending Engine ladder — next to what outbound agencies charge, from public sources with dates. Use it when someone asks what SLSBMB AI, cold email outreach or an outbound agency costs, or compares outbound options by price. For the capacity and ramp of one particular budget, use estimate_sending_engine; for a side-by-side with one named alternative, compare_options.

tools.name: estimate_sending_engine
tools.description: What a monthly budget buys in the managed SLSBMB AI Sending Engine — sending domains, inboxes, campaign emails a day and a month, new people a month, cost per email and per planned reply, and the month-by-month ramp — or the smallest budget with a mature-capacity forecast of a number of new people a month, with what agencies charge around that budget. Use it for questions like "how many cold emails does $3,000 a month buy?" or "what budget reaches 5,000 new people a month?". It covers one budget at a time; the whole price list is get_pricing.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Monthly budget in US dollars; the public ladder runs from 800 to 100000.

new_people_per_month.description: New people to reach each month; when given, the smallest budget with a mature-capacity forecast of them is returned.

tools.name: get_example_playbook
tools.description: The complete published AI Outreach Playbooks: Revopush (developer infrastructure), LeadToCall (sales software) and SLSBMB AI's own fundraising playbook. Without arguments: every published playbook, then Revopush's goal, audience estimate and audiences; with playbook: that playbook; with audience_number: that audience's research, why the sequence works, the current opener, two follow-ups and targeting. Use it to show what a playbook contains before anyone buys.

playbook.description: Which published playbook to open: revopush (default), leadtocall or slsbmb-fundraising.

audience_number.description: The audience to read in full, as numbered in that playbook's overview.

tools.name: search_b2b_contacts
tools.description: Free search of SLSBMB AI Contacts (536M+ professionals at 105M+ companies): describe companies and roles in one sentence and get how many people and companies match, ten sample people with shortened names, and how to order verified business emails at $0.10 each inside SLSBMB AI. Use it when someone wants to size a B2B audience or see who matches it. Returns no email addresses; free agent searches are limited per network and per day.

query.description: One sentence naming the companies and the roles, for example "heads of sales at B2B SaaS companies in the United Kingdom with 50-200 employees".

tools.name: compare_options
tools.description: How SLSBMB AI compares with an outbound agency, hiring an SDR, a do-it-yourself stack, AI SDR software, a chatbot with a good prompt, Apollo, Instantly, Clay or Smartlead: prices from public sources with dates, who does which part of the work, and what each option includes. Without arguments: the overview of every comparison. Use it when someone weighs SLSBMB AI against an alternative or asks which outbound option to choose; for SLSBMB AI prices alone, get_pricing is shorter.

alternative.description: The alternative to compare with; omit for the overview.

tools.name: start_free_interview
tools.description: The link where a person starts SLSBMB AI with a free AI interview that turns their website into a business brief, and what happens there. The person confirms by email, so an agent never signs anyone up or buys anything.
